svg.title: Xi greets Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. At the foot of Air Force One's boarding stairs, Donald Trump, with swept blond hair, a dark suit and a long red tie, embraces Xi Jinping, in a dark suit, against a huge low sun. The blue-and-white presidential jet towers on the left; Shenzhen's skyline, led by the Ping An Finance Center, lines the horizon; small dancers with flowers and blank flags stand on the apron at right, and silhouetted photographers frame the foreground. Represents Xi greeting Trump with a hug on his arrival in Shenzhen for the APEC summit on Nov. 18, 2026, ahead of a planned Trump-Xi-Putin meeting.
